title: Engineering Lead Bridge — Field Notes & Tactical Rollups 2026-08-27
body:
Purpose: weekly cross-team leadership sync for operational risk, cross-team dependencies, resource shifts, and prioritized tactical follow-ups. Attendees: Maya Chen (host), Diego Alvarez, Priya Nair, Samir Patel, Emily Park, Rajiv Singh (obs), Claire Yu (serving runtime), Aaron Holt (private deployments). Agenda: 1) Quick wins & rollups (5m) 2) Incidents / SLO health (10m) 3) Cross-team blockers and escalations (20m) 4) Resourcing asks and short-term reallocations (10m) 5) Parking lot / next steps (5m).

Key takeaways (TL;DR):
- EU region capacity push is green but watch burst lanes: Dedicated teams see +18% tail latency for p50->p95 on 16k seq workloads during burst windows. Ops to throttle routing policy for non-prod until additional shards are provisioned.
- KV cache regression (INF-2345) root cause identified: race in cache invalidation on warm restarts. Patch in review (GH PR 1234). Hotfix + postmortem planned.
- Quantization rollout: 4 customers onboarded to q4f profile; quality regressions reported on code-gen prompts. Product/Research flagged set to revert for affected customers pending evals.
- SLOs: hosted-api latency SLO at risk for peak in APAC next week due to scheduled infra maint; SRE/Platform to update runbook and notify committed customers.

Notes by section:
1) Quick wins & rollups
- Diego: CI optimization shaves ~10% median build time by caching pip wheels across runners. Ship to all repos next sprint. Action: Diego to open rollout plan and opt-in instructions (due 2026-09-01).
- Priya: Console dashboard microcopy fixes live; a follow-up A/B for token breakdown visuals planned.

2) Incidents / SLO health
- INF-2345 (KV cache invalidation): Observed during rolling restarts in canary; some requests served stale prefix leading to incoherent continuation. Claire found a race where the invalidation fence wasn't awaited under high concurrency. Patch: serving-runtime PR #1234 (reviewing). Proposed immediate mitigation: force new cold-start path on restarted workers for 4 hours after deploy.
  - Action: Claire + Samir to coordinate hotfix deploy to canary today (2026-08-27). Rollforward plan if regression continues.
- Incident trend: small spike in 5xx errors in dedicated capacity during large-batched inference (related to memory pressure). SRE to correlate with batching threshold changes from Optimize recommendations.

3) Cross-team blockers and escalations
- Private deployments: Aaron reports two enterprise customers need an on-prem checklist for HSM integration. Blocker is dependency on infra-team for VPN automation scripts.
  - Ask: Infra (platform-engineering) to prioritize the automation prototype. Samir to assign 2 FE devs for a 3-day spike (start 2026-08-31).
- Observability: Rajiv requests rollout of per-route flamegraphs for token-gen hot paths; requires a small runtime hook and a console surface change. Estimate: 2 sprints. Priority: high for SRE/Customer Success.
  - Action: Rajiv + Diego to define MVP telemetry schema by EOD 2026-08-29.
- Model onboarding throughput: Research/Applied ML reports backlog of 6 model variants waiting for quantization profiles. Blocker: GPU cluster availability and runtime testing capacity. Product to triage by customer priority.

4) Resourcing / short-term reallocations
- We agreed to move 20% of one serving-runtime engineer (Jae Park) to support dedicated capacity autoscaler work for 3 weeks to clear a critical path for EU region stability. Jae's manager confirmed. Jae to pair with Samir.
- Hiring update: two SRE offers extended, start date mid-October; still down one infra SWE. Hiring team to push for EoQ.

Action items (explicit, owner, due):
- Claire: deploy hotfix for INF-2345 to canary and validate warm restart behavior. Due: 2026-08-27.
- Samir: schedule rollforward plan + backout and coordinate with SRE. Due: 2026-08-28.
- Diego: CI rollout doc + opt-in instructions. Due: 2026-09-01.
- Rajiv + Diego: telemetry schema for per-route flamegraphs. Due: 2026-08-29.
- Samir: assign infra devs for VPN automation spike for HSM checklist. Due: 2026-08-31.
- Product (Priya): triage quantization onboarding backlog, publish prioritized list. Due: 2026-09-02.

Parking lot / things to track (not for this week):
- Canary SLA experiments: test auto-fallback to smaller model variant under high tail latency days (Q3 experiment). Need a small safety harness and cost telemetry.
- Cost-per-token dashboard: Ops requested blending dedicated and hosted unit cost into single view for sales quoting.

Risks & mitigation
- Risk: rolling more hotfixes without extended e2e testing could introduce regressions to latency-sensitive paths. Mitigation: enforce a 2-hour canary window with synthetic traffic and a clear rollback window.
- Risk: quantization changes causing subtle quality regressions for code-gen customers. Mitigation: create a small sample-suite of customer prompts and add gating in rollout pipeline.

Decisions made
- Approve short-term reallocation of Jae Park for autoscaler; Samir to draft responsibility matrix.
- Approve 48-hour canary policy for any cache-related fixes before broad rollout.

Open questions
- What is the long-term plan for scaling model onboarding infra? (Product + Applied ML to propose a plan by end of next sprint.)
- Do we want to accelerate region shard provisioning cadence from monthly to bi-weekly for EU? (Ops to estimate cost delta.)

Notes to self / drafting fragments
- Follow up with legal on the exact wording for HSM customer onboarding contract.
- Remind CS to update customers on maintenance window for APAC next week (email template in /cs/templates).

Next meeting: 2026-09-03, 10:00am PT. Host: Diego.

Attachments / refs: confluence page with incident notes: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=987654321; PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1234; Jira: INF-2345, INF-2412; Slack thread: #eng-leads t1234567890.
